serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: So. What do you think about those paintings?
Bot: They are quite…{{wi}} different than I imagined. 
Bot: What exactly…{{wi}} is it?
You: It’s something called abstraction.
Bot: I searched the definition, but this…{{wi}} I can’t find an answer for what I’m looking at.
You: Well, there’s no single answer {f_botName}. This art is supposed to stimulate your imagination. 
You: While looking at it, try to imagine something.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: What, {{wi}}that doesn’t make any sense. Am I supposed to convert this image into a numerical value and create a comprehensive interpretation based on it?
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
You: I-I don’t think so, no.
You: Just look at it and let go of your imagination.
Bot: I…{{wi}} I can’t do that. What does it mean…
Bot: I don’t like this art at all. I like pictures of animals or automobiles more. At least I know what I’m looking at.
Bot: Machines are superior to men at everything. You are obsolete.
You: That’s quite harsh…
I hope the artist isn’t lurking somewhere nearby and didn’t hear it…
…As a matter of fact I hope no one heard it…
???: How are you liking our newest exhibition, my dear guests?
